description: scATAC-seq Level 3 and 4 - Peak-by-cell matrices, fragment files, and chromatin accessibility metrics

ANNDATA_SCHEMA_VERSION.description: Version of AnnData schema (must be 0.1 for CellxGene compliance)

ANNDATA_STRUCTURE_VALIDATED.description: Whether the h5ad file structure has been validated against AnnData 0.1 schema

ATAC_GENE_ACTIVITY_WORKFLOW_PARAMETERS_D.description: Parameters used to run the scATAC-seq workflow.

ATAC_GENE_ACTIVITY_WORKFLOW_TYPE.description: Generic name for the workflow used to analyze a data set
ATAC_GENE_ACTIVITY_WORKFLOW_TYPE.title: ATACGeneActivityWorkflowTypeEnum

BLACKLIST_RATIO.description: Ratio of reads in blacklist regions

BLACKLIST_REGION_FRAGMENTS.description: Number of fragments overlapping blacklisted regions

DNASE_SENSITIVE_REGION_FRAGMENTS.description: Number of fragments overlapping with known DNaseI hypersensitive sites (DHS).

ENHANCER_REGION_FRAGMENTS.description: Number of fragments overlapping enhancer regions

FILENAME.description: Name of the file. Must end with an extension matching the FILE_FORMAT (.h5ad for h5ad, .bed for bed)

FILE_FORMAT.description: Format of the file (h5ad for peak by cell matrix and fragments information; bed for peak file)

GENOME_ANNOTATION_URL.description: URL to genome or transcriptome annotation

GENOMIC_REFERENCE.description: Genomic or transcriptomic reference assembly used for alignment. If your genome reference is not among the valid values, please contact your data liaison.
GENOMIC_REFERENCE.title: GenomicReferenceEnum

GENOMIC_REFERENCE_URL.description: URL to genomic or transcriptomic reference

HTAN_PARENT_ID.description: HTAN Parent ID(s) - Foreign key(s) to parent entity (B for Biospecimen, D for data file). One or more IDs; for aggregated files provide multiple. Each ID must have B or D suffix. Supports HTA200-229 for phase 2.

LIBRARY_PREPARATION_DAYS_FROM_INDEX.description: Number of days between when the sample for assay was received in the lab and the libraries were prepared for sequencing. If not applicable please enter 'Not Applicable')

MEDIAN_FRACTION_OF_READS_IN_PEAKS.description: Median fraction of reads in peaks (FRIP)

NUCLEOSOME_SIGNAL.description: Nucleosome signal score (strength of the nucleosome signal per cell, computed as the ratio of fragments between 147 bp and 294 bp (mononucleosome) to fragments < 147 bp (nucleosome-free))

N_COUNT_PEAKS.description: Total number of fragments in peaks

N_COUNT_RNA.description: Total number of fragments in genes

N_FEATURE_PEAKS.description: Number of peaks with at least one read

N_FEATURE_RNA.description: Number of genes detected in cell

ON_TARGET_FRAGMENTS.description: Number of fragments overlapping any of TSS, enhancer, promoter and DNase hypersensitivity sites (counted with multiplicity). Sanity check - must be <= PASSED_FILTERS (Level 2).

PEAKS_CALLING_SOFTWARE.description: Generic name of peaks calling tool

PEAK_REGION_CUTSITES.description: Total number of Tn5 insertion cutsites falling within peak regions (equal to 2 x PEAK_REGION_FRAGMENTS for paired-end sequencing).

PEAK_REGION_FRAGMENTS.description: Number of fragments overlapping peaks. Sanity check - must be <= PASSED_FILTERS (Level 2).

PROMOTER_REGION_FRAGMENTS.description: Number of fragments overlapping promoter regions

SEURAT_CLUSTERS.description: Clusters of cells by a shared nearest neighbor (SNN) modularity optimization based clustering algorithm

TSS_FRAGMENTS.description: Number of fragments overlapping with TSS regions

WORKFLOW_LINK.description: Link to workflow or command. DockStore.org recommended

WORKFLOW_VERSION.description: Major version of the workflow, or 'Not applicable' when no workflow version applies.
